name: aegis
description: Visual agent workbench — build graph workflows, run them, measure quality with guardrails & evals, and triage production like an ops console.

paragraphs: Visual agent development — with guardrails, evals, and ops built in.
Design graph workflows on a canvas. Run them against real inputs. Measure quality. Ship with confidence.
Aegis is an instrument for agent workflows — not a chat wrapper. You compose nodes on a dark, dense canvas, promote versions into production, and triage failures like an ops console.
features: Author — React Flow canvas with agents, tools, routers, joins, code, integrations, and RAG knowledge retrieval; per-node LLM provider/model selection (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Fireworks, OpenRouter, Featherless,…
Harden — Guardrail playground (deterministic rules, Presidio PII, prompt injection, LLM classifier, and pre-execution tool-call guardrails) before nodes go live.
Grade — Multi-dimension LLM evals with presets, pass thresholds, RAG retrieval metrics, and matrix experiments across models and datasets.
Operate — Observability triage: regressions, clusters, failed stream, cross-run trace search, feedback annotation queue, and OTLP / LangSmith tracing.
Ship & Deploy — Version, publish, and invoke the live graph via scoped API keys, signed webhooks, hosted chat sessions, or as an MCP server. Durable checkpoints survive server restarts.

whatItDoes.text: Visual agent development — with guardrails, evals, and ops built in.

requirements.text: Prerequisites: Node 20+, Python 3.12+, Docker (for Postgres), a Google API key with Gemini access (the default provider — OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and LiteLLM providers are optional per-node).
